title: Training Krea 2: What matters in generative model training — Sangwu Lee, Krea.ai
talk_summary: A research talk on training Krea 2, an image diffusion model, focused on data curation, captioning pipelines, and staged training (low-res pretraining through RL and prompt expansion).

takeaways.technique: Distill expensive LLM judges into cheap classifiers
takeaways.what_they_do: Use a large vision-language model to define a judgment (e.g. 'is this an AI image'), then distill that decision into a small CLIP-sized classifier that can run over billions of items cheaply.
takeaways.evidence_quote: distill this data this kind of like decision and like knowledge to like a very small like cichlip classifier

takeaways.technique: Filter out data the captioner systematically mis-describes
takeaways.what_they_do: They found the captioning model consistently omitted important aspects (e.g. a painting framed on a white wall), causing biased outputs, so they built filters to drop or undersample such data.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the captioner would like consistently like fail to mention this fact ... we just had to like design filters and then throw this kind of like data out

takeaways.technique: Two-pass captioning: extract facts, then rewrite to target format
takeaways.what_they_do: Run OCR and metadata extraction first, then a second VLM pass for a detailed caption, then rewrite into the JSON/prompt format the model consumes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we do a second pass with a visual language model to generate a very detailed caption ... then we can like rewrite it to like what like JSON prompts

takeaways.technique: Coverage check against a ranked concept list
takeaways.what_they_do: Compute PageRank over Wikipedia concepts and verify top concepts are represented in the dataset, filling gaps deliberately.
takeaways.evidence_quote: compute the page rank of each of the concepts ... make sure that like these kind of concepts are in our data set

takeaways.technique: Specialist experts distilled into one student
takeaways.what_they_do: Train capability-specialized experts (photography, text rendering) then merge into a single student matching each expert's strength.
takeaways.evidence_quote: train experts that are like specialized in like photography, text rendering ... merge all of these capabilities into a single student
